x: Lv = attacker level; Vigor = Vigor stat (“Strength”), Vig2 = Vigor x 2 capped at 255
BP = weapon Battle Power; Pwr = spell power; MagPwr = Magic Power stat (monsters: value x 1.5)
Def / MDef = target Defense / Magic Defense; Evade / MBlock = Evade / Magic Block (%)
All final damage is capped at 9999 per target.

blocks.x: Character (Fight, Capture, Blitz, SwdTech...). Base power comes from the weapon (or the Blitz power):
base = BP + 1.5 x (Lv² x (BP + Vig2) / 256)
Monster (monster Atk stat; a monster's Vigor is a random 56 to 63):
base = Lv² x (4 x Atk + monster_Vigor) / 256     (no x1.5 and no +BP)
Then, in this order:

x: Fight/Capture only (mod): Offering ÷2 (rounded up), then Genji Glove x3/4
Atlas Armlet: +50%; (the mod keeps: Earring +100% / single +50% for magic)
Gauntlet: the BP counts as 7/4 in the formula above
Variance: x (224 to 255) / 256, i.e. about 88% to 100%
Defense: x (255 − Def) / 256, then +1 (ignored by “ignores defense” attacks)
Safe on the target: x 170/256 (≈ 2/3); back row or Defend: ÷2 (they stack: ÷4)
Berserk, Morph (attacker), critical hit: multiplier x(1 + n/2); critical = 1 chance in 32, x2
A character attacking another character (Muddle...): ÷2
Elemental weakness x2; resistance ÷2; immunity 0; absorb: heals

blocks.x: Mod (Ultimate Damage): no more overflow past 65,535 (a huge attack no longer wraps to almost 0); Offering and Genji Glove now only reduce Fight and Capture (not Pummel, SwdTech, etc.).
base = 4 x Pwr + Lv x MagPwr x Pwr / 32

x: Earring: +100% (two Earrings) or +50% (just one); applied before variance
Variance: x (224 to 255) / 256
Defense: x (255 − MDef) / 256 + 1 (except spells that ignore defense)
Shell on the target: x 170/256; target in Morph: magic damage ÷2 (from the code)
Multiple targets: damage is usually split; some spells are not (“damage not divided”)
Elements: x2 weakness, ÷2 resistance, 0 immunity, absorb = heal

blocks.x: Healing: base = 4 x Pwr + Lv x MagPwr x Pwr / 32 as well (no defense); the same elements apply (inverted against the undead).
Physical attack (mod: Evade finally works):
hits if rand(0..99) < hit x (256 − 2 x Evade) / 256

x: hit: weapon (or monster) stat; Blind on the attacker ÷2; target with Beads (random dodge) ÷2
Evade ≥ 128: minimum multiplier (1/256) → nearly impossible to hit
Image: roughly one physical attack in four is absorbed (rand < 64/256) and removes Image
Always hits: target in Stop, Sleep, Petrify or Frozen; target in Retort stance; “never misses” spells
Magic attack: same calculations with MBlock, with no Blind or Beads.

blocks.x: Before the mod, Evade was never used (physical attacks read MBlock) and Blind/Beads did nothing. About twenty monsters with high Evade become harder to hit: Mover, Pugs, Scrapper, Punisher, Ursus, Borras, Cruller, Vindr...
Instant death (Doom, X-Zone, X-weapons...): misses if the target is protected; otherwise a Stamina check. The mod stops Vanish from bypassing death protection.
success chance = thief_Lv + 50 − target_Lv  (%)   ; x2 with the Sneak Ring
If the steal succeeds, the slot drawn is the rare or the common one; an empty slot makes the steal fail.
Mod (Locke): rare item 1 time in 4 (64/256) instead of 1 in 8 (32/256).
End-of-battle drops: rare item 1/8, common 7/8 (a single roll per monster, unchanged by the mod).
damage = (product of the dice) x Lv x 2     (ignores defense; bonus if the dice match)

Mod (Better Dice): one die always has an even 1-to-6 spread, the others get closer to it (vanilla: 1-4 at 3/16, 5-6 at 1/8); the matching-dice bonus also applies to 2-dice Dice; Offering divides dice damage.

In the original game SwdTechs had their own powers. In this mod the gauge fills twice as fast (one step every 64 frames instead of 128) and every SwdTech is a physical attack based on the weapon and Vigor:
damage = multiplier x (damage of a Fight)

x: Dispatch (Lv 1): x1.25, one target, ignores defense
Retort (Lv 6): counter x1.5, ignores defense
Slash (Lv 12): x1.5 + Sap; works on bosses (no more 50% HP / death check)
Quadra Slam (Lv 15): 4 hits x0.75 on random targets
Empowerer (Lv 24): x1 HP drain, then x0.25 MP drain
Stunner (Lv 34): x1 on all enemies + Stop (140/256)
Quadra Slice (Lv 44): 4 hits x1, ignores defense
Cleave (Lv 70): x1.5 on all + Death (182/256)

blocks.x: The learn levels and powers above are read from the modded ROM (Characters page > Cyan).
Blitzes are physical attacks: the Blitz power replaces the weapon BP in the physical formula (plus Vigor). Sabin learns them at levels 1, 6, 10, 15, 23, 30, 42 and 70.
Mod: the Blitz command opens a list (like Magitek); you pick the Blitz then the target, no more entering button combinations. Unlearned Blitzes show up empty.

x: Sketch (Relm): copies one of the monster's 2 “Sketch” attacks; success depends on the level ratio (Beret improves it); monsters marked “Not Sketchable” fail
Control: the monster performs one of its 4 “Control” attacks; Coronet improves success
Rage (Gau): Gau acts as the learned monster and uses the Rage attack on its page; “(Special attack)” = the monster's special attack
Lore (Strago): magic formulas using Strago's MagPwr; learned by being hit by the attack; not learned if Strago is KO'd

blocks.x: HP, MP and stats grow per level according to the game's tables; Esper bonuses apply at the next level-up (see More > Espers). Max HP/MP can be raised by relics (+12.5%, +25%, +50%). The HP/MP/EXP tables read from the ROM are under More > Tables.
A character who joins late gets a level close to the party average (each character has its own offset: see their pages).

mods.title: Evade (physical)
mods.text: Physical attacks use Evade; Blind and Beads work. About twenty monsters become harder to hit.

mods.title: Vanish / Doom
mods.text: Vanish no longer lets Doom or X-Zone kill targets protected against instant death (bosses included).

mods.title: Ultimate Damage
mods.text: No overflow past 65,535; Genji Glove and Offering only reduce Fight and Capture.

mods.title: Dead Hare
mods.text: A monster already removed from battle (killed by the Scimitar, etc.) no longer counterattacks.

mods.title: Item/Magic Counter
mods.text: Monsters that only counter one specific spell/item (SrBehemoth, FlameEater...) no longer counter everything afterwards.

mods.title: Zombie/Rippler
mods.text: Rippler no longer swaps hidden statuses; a Zombie cured by Rippler recovers 1/8 of its HP.

mods.title: Imp's Retort
mods.text: An Imp Cyan whose Retort fails no longer counters for the whole battle.

mods.title: Self Sneeze
mods.text: The Fake Mustache link is cut when Relm uses Palidor or if a side disappears.

mods.title: Dead in the Air
mods.text: Condemned during a Jump: Wound instead of staying at 0 HP; items restored after every battle; Esper +30% HP/MP bonus fixed.

mods.title: Smoke and Mirrors
mods.text: A Muddled character's Smoke Bomb no longer removes the monsters (and thus the victory) in their place.

mods.title: Soul Saved
mods.text: Soul Savers are immune to instant death: X-Zone can no longer end the Wrexsoul fight.

mods.title: Morph Mayhem
mods.text: The Morph gauge no longer drops during Sleep/Stop/Frozen, during Quick, or after leaving battle.

mods.title: Rock Bottom
mods.text: Near Fatal is reapplied when Petrify is cured below 1/8 HP.

mods.title: Status Unknown
mods.text: Statuses without an outline color (Life 3, Float...) no longer show up blank.

mods.title: Imp Skimp / Imp's Rage / Imp's Call
mods.text: Imp sprite tied to the status; Rage and Dance forbidden while Imp; an Esper cancelled by Imp is no longer lost.

mods.title: Shadow's Status
mods.text: Lasting statuses are removed from Shadow after the Floating Continent.

mods.title: Stone Faced / Stone Cold
mods.text: Petrified monsters no longer repeat their attack; Petrify no longer blocks Revivify.

mods.title: Killer Life 3
mods.text: An undead monster killed by an X-weapon no longer revives with Life 3 only to die again.

mods.title: Zombie/Tapir
mods.text: A Tapir that cures Zombie restores 1/8 max HP.

mods.title: Double Block / Half Knife
mods.text: A Fenix Down is no longer blocked twice by a shield; Offering also halves the ValiantKnife bonus.

mods.title: Bye Bye Breath / Off Death Row / Throwback
mods.text: Crashes in the 2nd Phunbaba fight fixed; Safety Bit and Memento Ring remove Condemned; Shadow throws normally at a target in Jump.

mods.title: Menu Malarky
mods.text: No more event skipping through the menu (Locke and the South Figaro guard, Inferno, Poltergeist).

mods.title: Returner's Day Off
mods.text: Two events fixed for Gau left on the Veldt (forgotten characters, softlock after Esper World).

mods.title: Shadow Gone / Shadow Copy
mods.text: No more empty party in Narshe without Shadow; Mimic no longer copies Shadow in the Dragon's Neck Colosseum.

mods.title: Game Over
mods.text: A defeat on the world map no longer leaves a pointer on the stack (softlock after 52 defeats).

mods.title: Map Mishap / Multiple Events / Bland Entrance
mods.text: Seven map issues, ten events and the game opening fixed (see the Leet Sketcher readme).

mods.title: Stepping Out / Trigger Happy / Walk This Way
mods.text: Holding Y no longer interrupts events; a timer event no longer runs past an event tile; diagonal stairs.

mods.title: Unequipium / Castle Party / Narshe's Door
mods.text: HP/MP refreshed when an event removes equipment; party order at Doma; Narshe's secret door.

mods.title: Anonymous Attack / Caravaggio / Chain of Command
mods.text: Kefka's attack at the Sealed Gate; Roulette via Sketch/Rage; Gogo's command names.

mods.title: Precious Jewels / Phoenix Chest / Off the Hook / Loud Music
mods.text: Gem Box without an ambush; Phoenix Cave chest; character above the hook; Opera House organ.

mods.title: Save Point Switch
mods.text: Switching parties in the Phoenix Cave/Kefka's Tower no longer lets you save or sleep away from a save point.

mods.title: Cyan: SwdTech
mods.text: Gauge 2x faster; all SwdTechs are physical, based on the weapon and Vigor (see Formulas).

mods.title: Locke: steal
mods.text: Rare item stolen 1 time in 4 instead of 1 in 8.

mods.title: Better Dice
mods.text: Setzer's dice better distributed, matching-dice bonus also for 2-dice Dice, Offering halves dice.

mods.title: Blitz menu
mods.text: Sabin's Blitz command opens a list; you pick the Blitz then the target.

sidequests.title: Cursed Shld → Paladin Shld
sidequests.text: The old man in Narshe gives the Cursed Shld. Fight 256 battles with a character other than Gogo wearing it to purify it into the Paladin Shld.

sidequests.title: Ragnarok
sidequests.text: The Narshe weapon shop owner lets you choose the Ragnarok Esper OR the sword: picking one loses the other (the sword can be traded at the Colosseum).

sidequests.title: Colosseum
sidequests.text: Wager an item to fight a monster and win a rare item (see More > Colosseum). The prizes are read from the ROM.

sidequests.title: Fanatics' Tower
sidequests.text: A tower with no magic: Gem Box, Safety Bit, Genji Shld, Stunner, Force Armor, Air Anchor.

sidequests.title: Veldt / Rages
sidequests.text: Gau learns Rages with Leap. The monsters met on the Veldt are in the Bestiary (World page).

sidequests.title: Water Harmony (Mog's dance)
sidequests.text: Mog must fight in water during the World of Balance (Lete River or Serpent Trench), otherwise it is lost for good.

sidequests.title: Force Field (Lore)
sidequests.text: Only learned from the Fiend statue in Kefka's Tower, in a single fight, with Strago present.

lore_hint: Who casts each Lore is read from the monsters' AI scripts (ROM).
